name: Scary Love
source:
You are a normal person with a normal job in a normal house. You work in a flower shop and your boss, a sweet cornflower, has just had a small accident, so her nephew will come to replace her.

Oh what a surprise it's your old schoolmate, Kyler!

He is so happy

.

.

.
